economy.zh:
今日全球市场分化明显：美股以芯片股领跌的科技抛售蔓延至亚洲，SK海力士暴跌11%，港股存储概念承压；但苹果AI合作传闻推动阿里、百度港股大涨，中概科技逆势走强。美联储主席沃什强调与特朗普政府'经常会面'并捍卫独立性，市场关注货币政策独立性风险。欧洲方面，ECB推进数字欧元试点并因霍尔木兹紧张重估利率前景。中国二季度GDP仅增4.3%创近四年新低，消费疲软但出口强劲，政策刺激预期升温。同花顺社区显示理财资金正在通过打新涌入一级市场，同时黄金ETF持仓小幅减持。

- **[SK海力士暴跌11%**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/sk-hynix-falls-amid-asia-tech-rout-tracking-us-semiconductor-losses.html) 亚洲科技股跟随美股芯片抛售，中美技术竞争加剧。
- **[阿里百度因苹果AI合作传闻大涨**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/alibaba-baidu-shares-jump-apple-ai-partnership-.html) 苹果在华AI合作伙伴传闻刺激中概科技异动。
- **美联储独立性争议升温**：前顾问因隐瞒中国关系被判刑，沃什频繁会见财长引发各界关注。
- **欧元区面临双重压力**：ECB启动数字欧元试点，同时霍尔木兹紧张局势推升油价，央行利率路径不确定性加大。
- **中国二季度GDP增速放缓至4.3%** 消费拖累明显，但出口和人民币资产开放带来支撑，市场期待更多刺激。
- **港股ETF市场创历史新高** 非传统ETF驱动资金流入，恒指升至一个月高点。
- **欧洲寻求技术自主**：法国德国希望减少对中美技术依赖，但面临现实选择困境。

**后续观察**：今日最大变量是美国芯片制裁情绪的外溢效应是否持续，以及中国政策窗口期是否在二季度数据后打开。苹果AI合作若确认将重塑中概科技估值逻辑，而霍尔木兹局势对能源价格和全球通胀的影响须持续跟踪。
economy.en:
The past 24 hours saw a confluence of macro and sectoral shifts: the Apple-AI partnership turbocharged Chinese tech stocks, while a global semiconductor rout deepened on US spillover. Monetary policy signals diverged—the Fed defended independence amid frequent White House meetings, the Bank of Korea hiked for the first time in three years, and the ECB advanced its digital euro pilot. China’s Q2 GDP slowed to 4.3%, fuelling stimulus calls, and US tariffs on Brazil added a new trade front. Corporate headlines ranged from Buffett’s personal stake in Alphabet to SpaceX falling below its IPO price.

- **Apple’s AI bet lifts Alibaba and Baidu**: Shares jumped in Hong Kong after Apple partnered with the two Chinese tech giants, intensifying the US-China AI rivalry. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/alibaba-baidu-shares-jump-apple-ai-partnership-.html))
- **Global chip selloff deepens**: SK Hynix plunged 11% as Asia tracking US semiconductor losses, dragging down Hong Kong storage-concept stocks. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/sk-hynix-falls-amid-asia-tech-rout-tracking-us-semiconductor-losses.html); [第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE9acGVaN0VxRnl1THNGU3l3SWhZZGFZaWtCcXBHckM1dWZscnh0QWhqVGVPdDNEZEFLYmJNcWdqSllqOEZVbkpnekRTNWxPem45bEhN))
- **Fed’s Warsh defends independence while meeting ‘often’ with Trump administration**; Beige Book showed World Cup boost but not broad growth. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/feds-warsh-says-he-meets-often-with-trump-administration.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/world-cup-economy-spending-alcohol-hotels-fed.html))
- **China’s Q2 GDP growth slows to 4.3%**, dragging first-half to 4.7%, as sluggish consumption and Iran war fallout offset strong exports. Stimulus expectations rise. ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/plus/economy/china-economy/article/3360648/chinas-slowing-economic-growth-boosts-case-stimulus))
- **ECB selects 36 firms for digital euro pilot**; renewed Hormuz hostilities drive rate rethink amid ‘extremely volatile’ outlook. ([CNBC](https://news.google.))
- **US to impose new tariffs on Brazil**, replacing those struck down by Supreme Court. ([NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/15/business/economy/trump-brazil-tariffs.html))
- **SpaceX stock sinks below $135 IPO price** for the first time, falling fourth straight session. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/spacex-spcx-stock-ipo-price.html))

**Watch next**: The interplay between Fed independence and political pressure will be tested at upcoming FOMC meetings. China’s stimulus response to its GDP miss will be critical for global growth. ECB’s digital euro pilot and the Hormuz situation could reshape rate expectations. The chip rout may extend if US sector weakness persists.

## 社会新闻日报

**导语**：24小时内，全球地缘冲突持续升级，美伊互袭与俄乌互攻导致油价飙升，平民伤亡频发；中国经济增速放缓至4.3%引发担忧，而日本社会则录得过劳死赔偿新高。知乎社区动态聚焦AI商业化与客服困境。

- **美伊冲突白热化**：美国对伊朗发动新一轮空袭，特朗普警告德黑兰“最好老实点”，同时美军启动睾酮素筛查以提升战力 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9323zgq6wvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。油价受伊朗战争影响持续攀升，澳洲柴油已破2澳元/升 ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/16/divine-playhouse-josh-thomas-workplace-drug-survey-anthony-albanese-labor-angus-taylor-coalition-one-nation-pauline-hanson-ntwnfb))。
- **俄乌互攻加剧**：俄军导弹袭击基辅致2死，乌方则打击黑海20艘俄油轮，多个地区报告平民伤亡 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8929jv8kdzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/16/kyiv-under-fire-from-russian-missiles-after-eu-ukraine-sign-drone-deal?traffic_source=rss))。
- **中国Q2增速低于预期**：二季度GDP同比增长4.3%，为有记录以来最低之一，低于政府目标4.5%-5% ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/15/china-economy-low-quarterly-growth-economic-concerns))。同时上半年用电量增5.3% ([新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNMVBaakVyZUxIZnRuc19JTzc2YU4ydXpuc0NrekhTWlIyQTlxcWJRdi1uN1phcGh6cDdEMG5MMnhqRXFpYUxCTXoxMkhtcjhVLXNaYkpxb1dlNWlXN09hSzlBMmtDbXllY2FnelJGNTJrWW0yc05yZnJLdnhFSTI0RU1aY2tzMEE3))，显示能源需求韧性。
- **日本过劳死赔偿创新高**：2025年度记录补偿金支付额达历史峰值，反映职场压力危机 ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQeGJKVGhXUlkzVmdlRFJ3RFZrRC1RWTVsNnF0a0M4bjRtQ1lCQVNBLW1oc2FpSDBERHV1d0RrdkpWcF95WWM1Yk9RQlhkcXhmdEZldjNSWU1sc3dNT25wZk1odG1HREF0a2doN2FXTWNPZUFJSDlVbnduaEVQOWxUdGFwQTAtLWttRmxUb3B1VXU2cTRjbE90Skc0U3c))。
- **知乎平台转型承压**：知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源押注AI商业化 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))；同时“人工客服消失”话题引发公众不满 ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPSjN2c3ZMNGM3YUpkdnh3bWZHdFNpVWdjS0x6MkpOWjFjcTJrQWppN0J3c1plTi10X3I3RHd2eFNpM2U0VENYWFc3WFNuNkJsMTRvNmtacHQwdXBjXzRBdG4xWHBzc0JBTzU5eHVLODRJTHNubGhVMGs1a1laZG1yU0dhWG5kd0w2ajNQTlV3SmtwTE9GLW8tbWRqSUJ3Zk4wZkpPSWtjNUNrYVRTNlktVVZn))。
- **法国通过安乐死法案**：严格条件下允许绝症成年人协助死亡，经多年争论后终获批 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg7g2z4pv3o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突若持续升级，油价可能突破关键点位，对全球通胀构成二阶冲击；中国需关注财政与货币政策是否会加码以稳增长；日本“过劳死”纪录或推动劳动法改革讨论。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating geopolitical tensions, with US strikes on Iran and renewed Russian missile attacks on Kyiv after a Ukraine-EU drone deal. Economic signals are mixed: China's growth slowed to 4.3%, while US stocks flirt with records despite rising oil prices. Domestically, France approved an assisted dying law, Hong Kong police raided bookshops, and Japan recorded a record number of karōshi compensation payouts. On the tech front, Zhihu's revenue continued to slide, prompting a pivot to AI commercialization.

- **US-Iran Conflict Escalates**: The US launched fresh strikes on Iran, and President Trump warned Tehran to 'better behave', while remaining undecided on whether to 'finish off' Iran. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9323zgq6wvo)
- **Russia-Ukraine Missile Fire on Kyiv**: Two killed in Russian missile fire on Kyiv after Ukraine signed a drone deal with the EU. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/16/kyiv-under-fire-from-russian-missiles-after-eu-ukraine-sign-drone-deal?traffic_source=rss) Meanwhile, Ukraine hit 20 Russian Black Sea vessels, reportedly killing 14 civilians in Russian attacks. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8929jv8kdzo)
- **Falklands Banner Sparks FIFA Dispute**: Argentina players celebrated World Cup semi-final win over England with a banner claiming the Falkland Islands (Malvinas) as Argentinian, facing disciplinary action. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jul/15/malvinas-is-argentinian-world-cup-holders-celebrate-win-over-england-with-banner)
- **France Approves Assisted Dying Law**: French MPs passed a bill allowing assisted dying for terminally ill adults under strict criteria, after years of parliamentary debate. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg7g2z4pv3o)
- **China's Economy Grows at 4.3%**: One of its lowest rates on record, missing the government's 4.5-5% target, amid concerns over a lopsided recovery. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/15/china-economy-low-quarterly-growth-economic-concerns)
- **Hong Kong Police Raid Independent Bookshops**: Five arrested for selling 'seditious' books, highlighting ongoing crackdown on dissent. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq61660qpdpo)
- **Japan Logs Record Karōshi Payouts**: Record compensation for death from overwork and work-related illnesses, underscoring labor reform urgency. [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQeGJKVGhXUlkzVmdlRFJ3RFZrRC1RWTVsNnF0a0M4bjRtQ1lCQVNBLW1oc2FpSDBERHV1d0RrdkpWcF95WWM1Yk9RQlhkcXhmdEZldjNSWU1sc3dNT25wZk1odG1HREF0a2doN2FXTWNPZUFJSDlVbnduaEVQOWxUdGFwQTAtLWttRmxUb3B1VXU2cTRjbE90Skc0U3c)
- **Zhihu Revenue Down 23.6%, CEO Pivots to AI**: The Q&A platform accelerates AI commercialization as core revenue declines. [财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)

**Watch next**: Oil prices (already above $2/litre in Australia due to Iran war) will be a key economic lever; the Russia-Ukraine conflict may escalate further after the EU drone deal; China's policy response to its economic slowdown; and Japan's potential labor reforms after karōshi records.

military.zh:
**美伊冲突急剧升级，全球军事风险同步攀升**

过去24小时，美国在重启伊朗港口封锁的次日即对伊朗北部目标实施空袭，并拦截一艘试图突破封锁的油轮；伊朗革命卫队同步打击科威特和巴林，约旦击落来袭导弹，中东战火从海上扩至多国。与此同时，乌克兰政府突然换帅，台湾启动大规模导弹演练，印太方向同样紧张。以下为关键动态。

- **美伊进入直接交火阶段**：美国中央司令部对伊朗北部发动空袭，并逼停试图违反封锁的油轮，至今已有超过20艘美军战舰（含两个航母打击群）部署至中东 [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/first-full-day-of-resumed-u-s-blockade-on-iranian-ports-erupts-in-new-attacks)。伊朗革命卫队确认对科威特和巴林发动无人机/导弹打击，这是冲突首次外溢至海湾阿拉伯国家。联合国秘书长对此深表担忧 [China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQYjBQbXpiM2NiWW9VTE9lM0xjS3hGcGs2TVFVdjNtXy1kVmVsTnEtc012QWJ1RHpUdnpHbS04VWtRYkNtZVVCUjhuMnE0eDZ2MmNUd3g3eEh1M0dlYm5kbEZXNUhDdkNXWVp4aEc4UlJRQjh1aHdCcmg5aDdaYlJDNQ)。
- **全球军备采购加速**：沙特获批购买2万枚激光制导火箭，以应对无人机蜂群威胁 [TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/saudis-cleared-to-buy-a-whopping-20000-laser-guided-rockets)；五角大楼签订多年合同采购数千枚廉价巡航导弹，美空军首次从无人机试射远程导弹 [WSJ](https://news.google.)。这表明大国正为长期消耗战储备弹药。
- **乌克兰政府换血，无人艇战果惊人**：总统泽连斯基解职上任仅半年的国防部长费多罗夫，政府重大改组 [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/15/fedorov-out-as-ukraines-defense-minister-in-major-government-shake-up/)。乌军无人艇10天内攻击136次，逼近与俄军均势 [Eurasia Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPM2lGLWY0a0xuOHItcnlZUUVYVG9VblJCWjhRTXN3Rmd3WjhWNWZMVVdZQk4tLVdrUlNGQjFaNi1KOWJNNjl5NDViVDA4VEp3bDZ0V3BxWkhlUk1zamtJdlB0M0ZQOGxHWkFrVzBiNUREOGZlZFJwa1RSLTNNQ1VLMWpKRnB2dFR3VkFkQmlzdnk1RjFXM0wzN0FCbTFiUQ)。乌克兰与欧盟寻求联合武器生产，以维持长期战力。
- **中国南海与战略威慑**：中国机构发布报告驳斥南海仲裁案，强调菲律宾主张不具效力 [人民日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE1KYXpkVVVyZ3ZETGFzc3RBanFOYWhyY1BXR1I0VXpmRmRqWGpXcG9ncjhYVTVNcDBXUm9uT0FaNmstZ0RReFNIV216d0dGeW5aUnlIWks2ZEJnRTJVMkxvV3Y3Tm1meHhmdTN6RlQwbV9rRVphZkpaaHpqdk9idTA)。中国海军被曝进行水下战略导弹发射，释放强烈威慑信号 [风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9ZeTBSQlRnY095SWpTU1BvdFRzTFRnX2x3aEh0ZGFBVTNqV1pBcW0yZzRCczllR0I0N3VEOW05V3lNQlF5WDlzSlBFaVJha3NQbWdRcGZyemZNRGs)。美国会两党呼吁加强科研安全，阻断资金流向中国军工 [美国之音](https://news.google.)。
- **台日强化防卫**：台湾动员新购HIMARS和雄风反舰导弹进行五天实兵演练，聚焦反登陆与反舰作战 [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/15/taiwan-mobilizes-himars-anti-ship-missiles-for-major-defense-drill)。美国国会报告称日本首相高市早苗加速防卫政策变革 [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/15/report-to-congress-on-japans-evolving-defense-policy-and-the-u-s-japan-alliance)。英国海军“威尔士亲王”号航母在北大西洋演练混合无人作战，展示转型方向 [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/operation-firecrest-hms-prince-of-wales-hybrid-navy/)。

**后续观察**：未来48小时，美伊是否进一步打击伊朗本土目标、伊朗是否封锁霍尔木兹海峡将是最大变数。乌克兰新防长人选及对俄策略调整，以及台湾演习规模是否引发大陆反制，均值得跟踪。

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻格局清晰：汽车领域上演冰火两重天——比亚迪扬言超越丰田、特斯拉单日部署58辆Robotaxi，但NTSB确认致命事故为驾驶员100%油门操作，为自动驾驶安全性再添疑云；Lamborghini以“技术不成熟”为由将首款纯电推迟至2030年后，与Hyundai、Kia的低价EV攻势形成鲜明反差。AI赛道暗流涌动：微软被曝培训销售人员贬低OpenAI与Anthropic以推广自研模型，xAI则因Grok被用于生成CSAM而起诉用户，OpenAI用AI红队强化GPT-5.6防提示注入——安全与商业的张力持续升级。科技产品方面，Skullcandy借Bose ANC技术冲击中高端，Valve在用户抗议后澄清iFixit将继续供应Steam Deck电池，体现硬件生态中用户社群的影响力。HackNews社区关注Bluesky为AT Protocol注册商标引发的去中心化争议，以及一篇关于async/await并发陷阱的技术批判。整体看，行业正从狂热扩张转向精细化竞争，合规、安全、用户信任成为新护城河。

- [比亚迪已超越特斯拉，现在称丰田是下一个，且美国市场无关紧要](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPMjhGSnUzNXhuZWRTNXJ1TlhfQlRHa2RpT25kMEwyTnIyVkZMYTUxbzZ4dnc1cmg0SEU0bEJXMmJDNFBfc2xnNUZRRTQtazFIQW4zSjhpdWtJVE9YekV3STNrZFRXc3Zrb2twYW5DRXF0dnNLQXpRX3d1QkZaT2RIMDZmSW9lSm9qNm1iR2V0dUFMLTMzRzVpekRJMHZ4clJNWXZWNWFOZlljd3M) ——比亚迪全球攻势不再仅对标特斯拉，而是将丰田视为下一个超越目标，并明确表态不依赖美国市场。
- [特斯拉在德州一天内新增58辆Robotaxi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE0tbFd4dnRSSG9ZMHQ4RDM5NzhXR0FDN3Zwb0tOa2kwQnR1T2NjX2ZfTFRfZ2ZPeTJyM3JoOWEzRWh1aU9QVGd2R1JrUjFRWF90VDNMbUdtcTllb2duZVJMc1F5ZThyUmJscVh4MlY2N09nLTA)，同时NTSB确认得州致命车祸中司机100%踩下油门，否定Autopilot直接责任，但引发公众对自动驾驶命名与误解的担忧。
- [Lamborghini称电动车技术‘不够成熟’，首款纯电推迟至2030年后](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/lamborghini-ev-not-mature-enough/) ——与Hyundai、Kia积极降价推低价EV形成对比，超豪华阵营电动化节奏分化加剧。
- [微软被曝培训销售人员贬低OpenAI和Anthropic](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/15/microsoft-is-reportedly-training-salespeople-to-talk-down-openai-and-anthropic/) ——AI军备竞赛从技术延伸至话术战场，微软试图以效率、成本为卖点转移客户对第三方模型的依赖。
- [xAI起诉一名使用Grok生成CSAM深度伪造的用户](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/966293/xai-grok-user-lawsuit-csam) ——生成式AI滥用风险进入司法追责阶段，xAI此举意在划清模型责任边界。
- [OpenAI用AI红队强化GPT-5.6防提示注入攻击](https://news.google.) ——安全攻防从人工评估转向AI对抗AI。
- [Skullcandy与Bose合作，在新款Crusher耳机中植入Bose ANC和空间音频](https://www.theverge.com/tech/966022/skullcandy-cruser-1080-anc-bose-tuning-noise-cancelling-wireless-headphones) ——低端品牌借顶级技术向上破圈，可能重塑无线耳机市场格局。
- [Valve表示iFixit将继续销售Steam Deck电池，此前疑似断供引发社区抗议](https://www.theverge.com/games/966106/valve-ifixit-will-keep-selling-steam-deck-lcd-battery) ——用户力量倒逼厂商维持可维修性原则。

**后续观察**：比亚迪对全球市场的战略表态值得持续跟踪——若其成功突破丰田在东南亚、欧洲的腹地，全球EV竞争版图将加速重塑。微软内部销售话术的泄露表明AI行业正从技术竞赛进入客户争夺的存量博弈，企业间合作与竞争的界限愈发模糊。生成式AI法律案件频发（xAI诉讼、OpenAI安全强化）预示着监管窗口即将打开。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in tech saw a sharp divergence in EV strategies—from Hyundai's aggressive $5B battery bet to Lamborghini's retreat—alongside mounting AI safety and legal battles, a SpaceX IPO cooldown, and a vibrant Hacker News debate on concurrency and open protocols. Below are the key developments shaping the landscape.

- **EV market splintering**: Hyundai opens a $5B battery plant with SK On to push for #2 EV spot in the US ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/hyundai-opens-5b-battery-plant-push-for-americas-2-ev-brand/)), while Lamborghini pushes its first EV past 2030, calling EV tech "not mature enough" ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/lamborghini-ev-not-mature-enough/)). GMC’s Hummer EV sales drop 55% even as it launches a 25th-anniversary edition ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/gmc-hummer-ev-icon-25/)). Volvo plans two sub-$50k non-SUV EVs for the US ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/volvo-shake-things-up-two-new-50000-evs/)).
- **BYD signals Toyota as next target**, claiming the US market doesn't matter—underscoring China's export-led growth strategy ([Stocktwits](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPMjhGSnUzNXhuZWRTNXJ1TlhfQlRHa2RpT25kMEwyTnIyVkZMYTUxbzZ4dnc1cmg0SEU0bEJXMmJDNFBfc2xnNUZRRTQtazFIQW4zSjhpdWtJVE9YekV3STNrZFRXc3Zrb2twYW5DRXF0dnNLQXpRX3d1QkZaT2RIMDZmSW9lSm9qNm1iR2V0dUFMLTMzRzVpekRJMHZ4clJNWXZWNWFOZlljd3M)). Toyota’s US EV sales surged 136% ([AUTOJOSH](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9KamZGOVE0aXNxY01sTVoyd2JRRWdBZ1dyREZpWHpoRHBqYWFPNHNtNFhjSFJVdm1lUi1DV0t5bmNZN0xlWFg4VUE4cy1vWk9qWlh6eVpHVGFxV1ZMU3psa3IyZlp5djlFX2NNeUpZWlo5WFJJaGdV)).
- **Tesla robotaxis hit Texas**: 58 vehicles added in one day ([evxl.co](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE0tbFd4dnRSSG9ZMHQ4RDM5NzhXR0FDN3Zwb0tOa2kwQnR1T2NjX2ZfTFRfZ2ZPeTJyM3JoOWEzRWh1aU9QVGd2R1JrUjFRWF90VDNMbUdtcTllb2duZVJMc1F5ZThyUmJscVh4MlY2N09nLTA)), while NTSB confirms Tesla's account of a fatal Texas crash where accelerator was 100% depressed ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/15/tesla-driver-in-fatal-texas-crash-pressed-accelerator-100-ntsb-confirms/)).
- **AI safety and legal flashpoints**: xAI sues a user for generating CSAM deepfakes with Grok ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/966293/xai-grok-user-lawsuit-csam)); OpenAI uses an AI red team to fortify GPT-5.6 against prompt injection ([Decrypt](https://news.google.)).
- **SpaceX IPO price drops to $135** ahead of Starship launch, reflecting market sobriety on Musk’s promises ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/15/spacex-falls-to-135-ipo-price-ahead-of-starship-launch/)).
- **Solar milestone in Europe**: generated 52 TWh in June, 25% of EU electricity, becoming the largest source ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/15/solar-just-became-europes-biggest-source-of-electricity-heres-the-milestone-it-hit/)).
- **Hacker News debates deep tech**: async/await concurrency critique, Bluesky trademarking AT Protocol, and a paper on LLM comprehension of computer architecture go viral, while a guerrilla ad campaign mocks Kylie Jenner’s Meta glasses ([Hyperallergic](https://hyperallergic.com/guerrilla-london-bus-ads-mock-kylie-jenners-meta-glasses-campaign/)).

**Watch next**: The FCC vote on broadcast ownership caps on August 6 will reshape US media landscape ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/966283/fcc-broadcast-ownership-cap-brendan-carr)). In AI, the outcome of xAI’s lawsuit and Microsoft’s internal sales training to undermine OpenAI and Anthropic could shift enterprise AI adoption ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/15/microsoft-is-reportedly-training-salespeople-to-talk-down-openai-and-anthropic/)). On the EV front, Hyundai’s battery plant ramp and Volvo’s wagon-shaped EVs will test whether non-SUV form factors can revive demand.

sports.zh:
### 体育新闻板块导语
昨夜今晨，世界杯半决赛上演惊天逆转：阿根廷在亚特兰大2-1击败英格兰，第85分钟和第90+2分钟连入两球，终结了英格兰球迷60年的等待。这场比赛的余波贯穿了所有体育子板块——从虎扑社区对凯恩和恩佐数据的狂热讨论，到足球板块关于图赫尔战术争议的全面复盘，再到羽毛球日本公开赛的冷门新闻，以及篮球领域的零星动态。以下是今日不容错过的体育头条。

- **世界杯半决赛：阿根廷2-1逆转英格兰，梅西助攻制胜** — 阿根廷凭借劳塔罗·马丁内斯的补时绝杀，粉碎英格兰的决赛梦。赛后阿根廷球员展示马岛主权横幅，面临FIFA纪律处分。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c935pgr4dklo) 与 [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/england-vs-argentina/report/549867) 均指出，英格兰在领先后的保守策略是崩盘主因。
- **图赫尔未下课，但战术选择遭猛烈质疑** — FA表态继续支持图赫尔，但《每日电讯报》等媒体批评其换人（孔萨替换斯彭斯）导致中场失控。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8l15903k8o) 与 [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563777/thomas-tuchel-how-england-unravelled-after-ezri-konsa-substitution-as-familiar-failings-rob-three-lions-of-world-cup-final-place) 均进行了深度复盘。
- **凯恩数据揭示攻击乏力** — 凯恩全场13次带球仅推进27米，0次带球推进，凸显英格兰进攻端的低迷。[虎扑引用腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE43Mmhib3ZwWWpmOXlfeUZGamFwdHpRdWp1bTdXZGtla0ZoaG5Td1pPZnZuT3dSVlQ5UUhtejdCY2ZheHlSU01aR0RNRFpSNWhUVEtLYkFn)
- **阿德巴约自评83分当获ESPY大奖** — 前NBA球员阿德巴约在社交平台强调自己单场83分的成就，引发虎扑热议。[腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE5QRGlGNWtERzR4YU1MYk80ZXFTWk9sWk5FMnRZZlpnM29HRUNHUjhTMmNtdE5kM3I0aE5aNEZrS3ZIMGtSTHZGNkxqUW1tMGdFc0ZmSDdR)
- **羽毛球日本赛：李诗沣爆冷一轮游，石宇奇、陈雨菲过关** — 世界第8李诗沣1-2不敌日本选手田中涌士，遭遇巡回赛双杀。[Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQaWNVNzR3N3RWVDFsaXVjTWk4aVQ5dXJUZ1VvSGxqczdXRVRkUlJNNjRiWktsajBWZjJwbmstbXJDdEJoZFNVZ0daV1RidE1ITFc5dmZFbGt5a1VZWVdYVGZ5cXZINDZnY2NJNmV1YUlTUUNRQXcxWFU1aVdGZTVjdEJqbkNhMHVEY2tNZG5qQ293eFFGeExpdWVfTEJnajJ5eW5RTy13) 与 [新浪](https://news.google.) 报道一致。
- **篮球：公牛15号秀夏联9中0，杨瀚森青训引关注** — 戴林-斯温夏季联赛表现灾难，而杨瀚森在CBA青训体系的成长故事被深度挖掘。[MSN](https://news.google.) 与 [新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOR3dOalp0ZjdFbV8zWm5IUXdZM3ZBNGpiWEF3Tk1XQkMybnJNZGViS0NGNm0yMWRjRWdFNVRiSDJ5dTJHR2k4OW40ajZ3QkNtRnRqT2xzeDNDTXNFVVhPc2sxeDRoMDM2TWFkRmhXaWl0ZTZhNk9XcnlCYkQ2LW03RGVKQ3JxVXIzeVJ6VEQxalpiOE0)

**后续观察**：世界杯决赛阿根廷将迎战法国与西班牙的胜者，梅西有望冲击第三座大力神杯。英格兰方面，索斯盖特时代后的新周期如何重建，图赫尔的去留将成焦点。羽毛球日本公开赛冷门频出，国羽男单后备力量再受考验。
sports.en:
The sports world is reeling from a seismic World Cup semi-final, as reigning champions Argentina staged a dramatic late comeback to defeat England 2-1 in Atlanta, shattering England’s dreams of a first final since 1966. The match was marked by intense on-field clashes, tactical controversy, and post-match disciplinary threats. Meanwhile, the Japan Open badminton tournament saw a major upset, and the NBA summer league offered glimpses of future stars.

- **Argentina’s late show breaks English hearts**: Lautaro Martínez’s 90+2’ winner completed a stunning turnaround (Argentina trailed 1-0). Lionel Messi’s right-wing masterclass set up the winner, prompting BBC to call him [‘the king’](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8jnl9zdzn2o). England captain Harry Kane admitted [“holding on was not enough”](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563844/england-out-of-world-cup-harry-kane-says-holding-on-was-not-enough-against-argentina).
- **Tuchel’s defensive tactics under fire**: Manager Thomas Tuchel, who replaced Gareth Southgate, defended his approach (“no regrets”) but critics pointed to [“passive” second-half play](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8l15903k8o). Sky Sports detailed how a substitute [backfired spectacularly](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13563777/thomas-tuchel-how-england-unravelled-after-ezri-konsa-substitution-as-familiar-failings-rob-three-lions-of-world-cup-final-place). The FA continues to back Tuchel despite the defeat.
- **Falklands banner triggers FIFA probe**: After the match, Argentina players displayed a banner supporting their country’s claims to the Falkland Islands. BBC reports [disciplinary action is likely](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c935pgr4dklo).
- **Player ratings and raw data**: England’s Djed Spence shone, but stars like Bellingham, Rice and Kane failed to deliver ([Sky Sports ratings](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562938/england-vs-argentina-player-ratings-djed-spence-shines-for-three-lions-but-jude-bellingham-declan-rice-and-harry-kane-fail-to-deliver)). Kane’s advanced stats were notably poor: [13 carries, only 27m progressive distance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE43Mmhib3ZwWWpmOXlfeUZGamFwdHpRdWp1bTdXZGtla0ZoaG5Td1pPZnZuT3dSVlQ5UUhtejdCY2ZheHlSU01aR0RNRFpSNWhUVEtLYkFn). Enzo Fernández had [104 touches and 4 shots](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5Wc1lPcS1uTkxiNzNqYmU0Tk5aNXJ4ckNvRS1kbTFtemFaY0xBa0pIb1ljVkllMTlpN084RmFoYlBVa3dNRzZFdHJ1MnVrdjRVNVB6UHg5cw), both game-highs.
- **Argentina face France or Spain in final**: The final opponent will be decided in the other semi-final. Barcelona president Laporta [traveled to Dallas to watch Spain vs France](https://news.google.).
- **Badminton upset in Japan**: World #8 Li Shifeng (China) [lost 1-2 to Tanaka Yushi](https://news.google.) in the first round, while Olympic champion Chen Yufei and Shi Yuqi advanced safely.
- **NBA summer league and rookie news**: Chicago Bulls’ 15th pick Darin Swain [shot 0-for-9 in a summer league game](https://news.google.). Meanwhile, 2026 13th pick Emoni Bates flashed his signature smile in a photo shoot.
- **Boxing crossover**: A welterweight title fight between Conor Benn and Ryan Garcia [has been announced for September 12 in Las Vegas](https://www.skysports.com/boxing/news/12040/13561973/conor-benn-vs-ryan-garcia-wbc-welterweight-title-fight-announced-in-las-vegas-on-september-12).

**Watch next**: All eyes turn to Sunday’s World Cup final between Argentina and either France or Spain. The Japan Open badminton continues with second-round matches featuring top seeds. NBA free agency and summer league remain in focus, while the Hamilton-Ferrari narrative picks up steam ahead of the Belgian Grand Prix.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐新闻亮点频出：韩剧《新职员4》剧本阅读公开，延续黑色喜剧风格，而宝莱坞电影《Dhurandhar》进军日本市场，试图挑战韩流在亚洲的统治地位；微博社区围绕张碧晨“弃赛声明”和逐玉演唱会主演缺席展开热议，背后折射出明星行程管理与粉丝期待之间的张力；欧美方面，《蝙蝠侠2》首曝剧照，老演员Hal Williams去世，昆汀退休计划引发诺兰评论。中国影视行业则呈现活跃态势，艺人驰援辽宁捐赠、影视板块领涨市场。以下为各子专栏详细报道。

- [Watch: Kim Dong Jun, Kim Min Ho, And More Show Excitement And Passion At Script Reading For “New Recruit 4”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855075wpp/watch-kim-dong-jun-kim-min-ho-and-more-show-excitement-and-passion-at-script-reading-for-new-recruit-4) 韩剧《新职员》第四季剧本围读公开，该系列以黑色喜剧描绘军营文化，新季聚焦20代后半段的年轻人，值得关注其社会讽刺深度。
- [Dhurandhar Lands in Japan — But Can Bollywood Crack the One Asian Market Where Korean Cinema Ate Its Lunch?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPbzBxWEJDcUN6Q3owTnhzNnlWTmc1MW1KS0diR1Q5dGZUNVRHV014MWZHdjl2MGxvcExZLTlLeTJjam5XTFhpMG9za3Z5YlU1clp0VDBGdUVtSERGMExiYmpVbUpjS2VvZkY2ZVpzbWV6T2tqdkM5aEg1V2VFdEdwSGZYbFNVYmNicjJrNVY0dDJxQnV6clZTUE9FREtmTkZYTElxQ0dXVQ) 宝莱坞进军日本市场面临韩流强势竞争，这一跨文化挑战可能重塑亚洲电影格局。
- [Namkoong Min Executes A Bold Plan Against Kidnapper Kim Dae Myeung In “The Husband”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855119wpp/namkoong-min-executes-a-bold-plan-against-kidnapper-kim-dae-myeung-in-the-husband) 南宫珉新剧《丈夫》揭示丈夫营救妻子的紧张情节，延续悬疑题材热度。
- [Seo Yea Ji Signs With New Agency](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855115wpp/seo-yea-ji-signs-with-new-agency) 徐睿智签约新公司B.Wave娱乐，偶像复出之路值得关注。
- [为何热搜词条将张碧晨的行程冲突包装成“弃赛声明”？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1fcXJhekZOcGNUbnNQc1V5bEt6N2ZyekhhWHNsSnZxVGsxNlhjSEF1MU5LOFJ1RHBjVHgxQUlSellwRWVXM3VPSG5lSkNtaEl1MjJ6b1NSMHRwaVYyRXVVTkc3V1hkQjhiYTIwN3p0ZTA5QQ) 媒体将张碧晨的行程冲突定性为“弃赛声明”，引发粉丝质疑，背后是娱乐行业舆情操控的典型案例。
- [仅两千人想看逐玉演唱会 主演缺席引发热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1oWkJyUkJlVDlHeHNoOFUzcHRyTDZlLUJMVFI4SzgwZ0c1dlVFSU0tSGtiTVpRdThMNTdIWlhSb1kyNExuM2VWbFVhZzlrS0hCZlBoa2V3YU1GOHo0M1ZjVW9uVUw3Z2ZWbS1hNElqSE1uOEpN) 逐玉演唱会因主演张凌赫、田曦薇缺席，仅两千人想看，反映出粉丝对“挂羊头卖狗肉”的不满。
- [Matt Reeves Shares First Look At Robert Pattinson In ‘The Batman Part II’](https://deadline.com/2026/07/matt-reeves-first-look-robert-pattinson-the-batman-sequel-1236983532/) 《蝙蝠侠2》首曝剧照，虽延期至2028年，但导演里夫斯发布预告维持热度。
- [Quentin Tarantino Plans to Retire After His Next Movie. Christopher Nolan Hopes He ‘Won’t Stay True’ to His Word](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/christopher-nolan-criticizes-tarantino-retiring-after-10-movies-1236810994/) 昆汀计划拍完第十部电影后退休，诺兰公开表示希望他食言，两位导演的隔空对话引发影迷热议。
- [陈小春、汪苏泷、魏大勋等艺人捐款驰援辽宁](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTFB6ZTl4T3pRNVRrb1pRT1g0dzhaWV9BSXNyaVVSTGhyT1RDamQxWFNqS1p2V05VSExNQVBUMTRkRXhiQnFlYlJSYW5qVlZtSkhwS05iWDlhd0s2azlp) 多位内地艺人向辽宁灾区捐款，展现社会责任感，也带动公众关注。

**后续观察**：今日新闻呈现三大趋势：一是韩流内容生产依然旺盛，但宝莱坞试图渗透日本市场暴露了韩流护城河的松动；二是微博社区对明星行程和演唱会质量的监督情绪高涨，可能倒逼主办方加强透明度；三是好莱坞大导演之间的互动（昆汀vs诺兰）为电影圈提供了可持续的话题。跨领域看，张碧晨事件与逐玉演唱会都指向粉丝对“诚意”的敏感度上升，未来娱乐营销需更谨慎。

Today's entertainment landscape is marked by a mix of K-drama casting news, Chinese social media controversies, Hollywood obituaries, and Bollywood's push into Japan. Key developments include a new agency signing for Korean actress Seo Yea Ji, a viral dispute over a Chinese singer's schedule, and the passing of beloved 'Sanford and Son' actor Hal Williams. Meanwhile, China's film and television industry shows resilience with a stock market uptick and a surge in celebrity charitable donations.

- **Seo Yea Ji joins B.Wave Entertainment** after a period of agency uncertainty, signaling a potential comeback for the actress. [Read more](https://www.soompi.com/article/1855115wpp/seo-yea-ji-signs-with-new-agency)

[List](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTFB6ZTl4T3pRNVRrb1pRT1g0dzhaWV9BSXNyaVVSTGhyT1RDamQxWFNqS1p2V05VSExNQVBUMTRkRXhiQnFlYlJSYW5qVlZtSkhwS05iWDlhd0s2azlp)

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the Paramount-WBD merger court hearings and the debut of Lana Del Rey's companion album 'Stove.' Also, the 'Knowing Bros' idol leader special and the 'New Recruit 4' script reading hint at strong Korean variety and drama output for the coming weeks.

美股.zh:
美股市场延续分化：芯片板块遭重挫拖累纳指，但中概股因AI合作传闻逆势爆发。同时美联储高层人事与独立性争议持续，前顾问获刑，现任主席沃什频繁接触特朗普团队。

- **[SK海力士暴跌11%**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/sk-hynix-falls-amid-asia-tech-rout-tracking-us-semiconductor-losses.html) 追踪隔夜美国半导体损失，亚洲芯片股集体溃退。
- **[阿里、百度港股大涨**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/alibaba-baidu-shares-jump-apple-ai-partnership-.html) 苹果AI合作伙伴传闻利好，反映中美科技合作仍具想象空间。
- **[SpaceX跌破IPO发行价**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/spacex-spcx-stock-ipo-price.html) 连续四日下跌，进入纳斯达克100后未能止跌。
- **[沃什称与特朗普政府“经常会面”**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/feds-warsh-says-he-meets-often-with-trump-administration.html) 市场担忧美联储独立性和货币政策政治化。
- **[美联航业绩超预期**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/united-airlines-ual-2q-2026-earnings.html) 但预警60亿美元燃油成本增加，航空业面临能源价格压力。

短期看，芯片板块风险偏好恶化可能延续，但AI主题和苹果合作消息为市场提供结构支撑，需关注特朗普对巴西新关税及美联储政策路径变化。
美股.en:
US equities face cross-currents: tech gets a China-AI boost from Apple’s partnership, but a broader chip selloff and Fed uncertainty weigh. The Fed chair’s defense of independence amid frequent White House meetings adds policy risk, while consumer signals from the Beige Book show only a World Cup bump.

- **Apple’s AI partnership** with Alibaba and Baidu drove a Hong Kong tech rally, but the US-listed counterparts may see similar sentiment. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/alibaba-baidu-shares-jump-apple-ai-partnership-.html))
- **Semiconductor rout** continued: SK Hynix -11% in Asia, tracking US chip losses. This affects memory and AI hardware plays. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/sk-hynix-falls-amid-asia-tech-rout-tracking-us-semiconductor-losses.html))
- **Fed Chair Warsh** meets ‘often’ with Trump administration, defends independence; Beige Book highlights consumer warning signs despite World Cup boost. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/feds-warsh-says-he-meets-often-with-trump-administration.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/world-cup-economy-spending-alcohol-hotels-fed.html))
- **Buffett initiated Berkshire’s Alphabet stake**; **SpaceX** fell below IPO price; **United** earnings beat but flagged $6B fuel cost headwind. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/warren-buffett-tells-cnbc-he-initiated-berkshire-hathaways-investment-in-alphabet.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/spacex-spcx-stock-ipo-price.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/15/united-airlines-ual-2q-2026-earnings.html))
- **New US tariffs on Brazil** add trade uncertainty; ex-Fed advisor jailed for lying about China ties. ([NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/15/business/economy/trump-brazil-tariffs.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/ex-fed-adviser-gets-jailtime-lying-about-china-ties-economic-espionage-.html))

**Signal**: The AI rally in Chinese names may provide a lift to US-listed tech, but chip weakness and political risk around Fed independence could cap gains.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲市场焦点集中在数字欧元试点启动和地缘政治对货币政策的影响。ECB正式选定36家支付服务商推进数字欧元试用，同时霍尔木兹紧张局势导致油市波动，迫使央行重新考虑利率路径。

- **[ECB启动数字欧元试点**](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPVTVUNm56SkFCT3FLQW14MFdsakpXWXhIY01UNkFtOVJnZGhfczVtbmYzMVZwS2pWY2hSS3BuNkdCUDlkRDFFN3JCS1NteE5WZ1hDYW80c0t3dkg1RTRyT1VIY1pTUzAtS1J2OWxLVjhKa0h5Nk5NT3ctSFZKdVRYYlNLWjYxSURNNzFINzNkOUlMVmRqSUtFNQ) 36家支付服务商入选，旨在减少对美元依赖。
- **[霍尔木兹冲突或迫使ECB重定利率**](https://news.google.) 地缘风险推高油价，央行面临“极度波动”前景。
- **[欧洲寻求数字技术自主**](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/16/world/europe/digital-autonomy-ai.html) 法德试图减少对美中技术依赖，但选择困难。
- **[韩国央行加息至2.75%**](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/16/bok-interest-rate-monetary-policy-markets-kospi-skhynix.html) 三年多来首次加息，对亚洲其他经济体有示范效应。
- **[希腊外籍工人逃离加剧劳动危机**](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOY1BaTGVmclpvdHY4Ni1TZGI0My1YTG1uY0s3dW5nNUcwMEIyMW0wNEp2RTBZMVpfYUMxU2ZacUtONUJ2QVFDMnRKSGl6aTdHeW9rcG85Q2hMQWVMSDQ4UV95emxpN19QRy03V29vdnlZUTVQdmlNZklBbmhrNW92N3lmbXZqY0RRVURYYzNvZEhaRHc1ZTg3V19aZVAtdw) 劳动力市场结构性矛盾深化。

欧洲央行在通胀与增长之间更加两难，数字欧元虽是长期布局，但短期无法改变美元依赖，市场关注下周CPI数据。
